Definition: from G3844 and a derivative of G4632; to furnish aside, i.e. get ready:--prepare self, be (make) ready.
BiblicalUsage: Paraskeuazo means to get ready, to make preparation. Paul says in 1 Corinthians 14:8 that if the trumpet gives an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle? And in 2 Corinthians 9:2 he tells the Corinthians he has boasted that Achaia was ready a year ago, so their zeal has provoked very many.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that readiness is a gift to others: a clear trumpet steadies an army, and a church ready to give stirs the rest to give too.
